# Credentials from Leading Global Organizations and Universities

I have completed professional certificates and specializations from globally recognized organizations and universities, including **IBM, Microsoft, Google, DeepLearning.AI, Stanford Online, Vanderbilt University, the University of Michigan, the University of Maryland, and the Hong Kong University of Science and Technology**.

These credentials complement my academic background in Economics and strengthen my practical capabilities in **Data Analytics, Data Science, Machine Learning, Business Intelligence, Artificial Intelligence, survey research, financial analysis, and statistical modelling**.

The verification buttons below provide access to official credential pages where links are currently available.
